opportunities.title: Art Scholarship Under 18s

amount.raw: Each institution can apply for a maximum total award of £475,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions or registered charities in the UK that can evidence outstanding quality teaching.
opportunities.summary: Supports arts training for school‑age children under 18 outside regular school hours, funding scholarships and outreach activities.

opportunities.title: Art Scholarship Under/Postgraduate

amount.raw: Each institution can apply for a maximum total award of £475,000; bursaries of £5,000–£10,000 per student per year

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions or registered charities in the UK that offer undergraduate or postgraduate taught programmes.
opportunities.summary: Provides bursaries for outstanding undergraduate or postgraduate students in fine and performing arts who lack financial means.

opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: Year 1: up to £56,000 (100% salary); Years 2‑3: up to £28,000 (50% salary) plus up to £6,000 research expenses per year

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers who have not yet held a full‑time permanent UK academic post, hold a doctorate, and meet recent‑post‑PhD criteria.
opportunities.summary: Supports early‑career researchers to undertake a significant piece of publishable work, with joint funding of salary and research expenses.

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Retired or partially retired UK university researchers who have lived in the UK ≥26 weeks per year and held a teaching/research post.
opportunities.summary: Provides modest funding for senior retired researchers to complete or disseminate outstanding research outputs.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Doctoral Scholarships

amount.raw: Ten awards of up to £5 million total (funding up to 30 centres, 18 UK‑home and 6 international doctoral scholarships per centre)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities with research degree‑awarding powers (or consortia of up to two such universities).
opportunities.summary: Provides large‑scale, interdisciplinary doctoral scholarship programmes, including support for under‑represented groups and post‑doctoral pathways.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres

amount.raw: Up to £10 million per centre (up to 10 years)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities (including Oxford, Cambridge, Imperial) with research degree‑awarding powers; single or collaborative centres encouraged.
opportunities.summary: Supports ambitious, interdisciplinary research centres aiming for a step‑change in scholarship on a topic of the Trust’s remit.

opportunities.title: Major Research Fellowships

amount.raw: Salary costs (full‑time lecturer scale) plus up to £6,000 research expenses per year

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Distinguished researchers in humanities or social sciences employed at a UK university; previous holders ineligible.
opportunities.summary: Provides salary support for established researchers to complete a major piece of original research.

opportunities.title: Philip Leverhulme Prizes
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers in UK universities (permanent post or long‑term fellowship) who earned their doctorate within 10 years of the deadline.
opportunities.summary: Awards outstanding early‑career researchers for internationally impactful work; funds may be used for any research‑related purpose.

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants – Detailed Applications

amount.raw: Maximum grant value £500,000; up to 3 years duration

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities (and, on a trial basis, UK‑based independent research institutes) with research degree‑awarding powers.
opportunities.summary: Supports innovative, original research projects across all eligible disciplines, with a strong emphasis on interdisciplinary work.

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK university (or specialist arts institution) coordinating the visit; host must have research degree‑awarding powers.
opportunities.summary: Funds short‑term visits by eminent overseas scholars to enhance UK research capacity and skills in under‑represented areas.

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards

amount.raw: Up to £1 million per award (4–5 years)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career UK university staff (permanent lecturer level or nominated) with ≤2 years post‑PhD experience, no prior leadership award.
opportunities.summary: Supports talented early‑career scholars to build and lead a modest research team, developing research leadership and impact.
